mechanism: Direct visible-coordinate program. Background = palette[0] (the only specialised constant; d4 is unused, and the emitted source is identical for all 8 D4 indices). Frame-capable colour: its cells are exactly the border of its >=3x3 bounding box, and the ring just inside that border is background (the native constructor reserves that ring). Role readings: every split into k frame colours and k pixel colours, k=2 if min(H,W)<=20 else 3, where the frames' ceil(area/2) needs are distinct and equal the pixel counts as a multiset; boxes are <= side//2 and separated by >=1 cell. Output: erase all pixel colours, then fill each interior with a checkerboard in the matched colour. Phase hypotheses are the 4 anchor corners (the D4 orbit of the native top-left rule). A corner survives only if it reproduces EVERY demo exactly under some role reading. A demo that no hypothesis explains makes the program return None: no skipping and no reset. The program answers only if every (query reading x surviving corner) renders the identical full grid; otherwise it returns None. There is no first-candidate, majority or d4 fallback. Pixels deep inside an interior (a native quirk: only the interior border is reserved) and adjacent same-colour pixels are both handled.
independent_gate: df8cc377_gate.py uses a majority background, flood-fill frames, bitmask role enumeration, and GF(2) elimination of one parity equation per demo frame, with the phase read from the demo output. Its statuses are: unique / phase_context_shortfall (context) / role_ambiguous (intrinsic) / demo_*. It sees demos plus the query input only.

assumptions: The hypothesis family is the 4-corner D4 orbit of the native anchor rule; global-parity or other anchors are not in the augmented distribution.
The constructor's visible layout constraints are used as hard domain constraints. True native draws always satisfy them, so they only remove spurious readings.
changes_vs_v3_proposal: v3 required an all-background interior, which wrongly rejects real frames when a pixel lands deep inside an interior (the native quirk). It also silently ignored demos that no hypothesis explained, and kept a non-strict fallback tier. Here the interior check is limited to the reserved ring, an unexplained demo causes abstention, and there is no tier fallback.
constructor_notes: The random layout loop is unbounded (operational only). The archived solver's size>1 frame split breaks on adjacent same-colour pixels; that defect is not reproduced here.
teaching_context: One native demonstration supplies missing horizontal checkerboard phase. Original context still abstains. Production contexts require independent evidence gate; query remains fixed while demos are resampled.
